title: Girl
lyrics_synced:
[00:02.02] Is there anybody going to listen to my story?
[00:08.09] All about the girl who came to stay.
[00:13.03] She's the kind of girl you want so much
[00:15.96] it makes you sorry;
[00:18.88] Still, you don't regret a single day.
[00:23.60] Ah, girl! Girl!
[00:34.61] When I think of all the times I've tried to leave her
[00:40.45] she will turn to me and start to cry;
[00:45.39] And she promises the earth to me
[00:48.31] and I believe her.
[00:51.24] After all this time I don't know why.
[00:55.96] Ah, girl! Girl!
[01:07.42] She's the kind of girl who puts you down
[01:10.56] when friends are there, you feel a fool.
[01:18.20] When you say she's looking good
[01:20.67] She acts as if it's understood.
[01:23.37] She's cool, cool, cool, cool,
[01:28.82] Ah, girl! Girl!
[01:39.33] Was she told when she was young that pain
[01:42.02] would lead to pleasure?
[01:45.17] Did she understand it when they said
[01:50.11] that a man must break his back to earn
[01:53.03] his day of leisure?
[01:55.96] Will she still believe it when he's dead?
[02:00.67] Ah, girl! Girl!
[02:33.71] Girl!
[02:39.10] Girl!
[02:44.49] Girl!
[02:49.89] Girl!
[02:55.28] Girl!
[03:00.67] Girl!
